rss: AI is less regulated than milk, says Microsoft president
title: Robot Rules Needed, Expert Says
story: An expert said robots need more rules like how we have rules for milk. As robots get smarter, it's important to have rules to keep things fair and safe.
storyBig: A tech leader highlighted the lack of regulations in AI compared to everyday regulated goods like milk. This calls for global standards to ensure safe and ethical AI development.
think: What other things need rules to be safe?
bull: More robot rules can make things safer.
bear: Too many rules might slow down robot fun.

rss: Citroen revives the 2CV for an electric age
title: Old Cars Get New Electric Power
story: An old car is getting a new battery that runs on electricity. This helps the environment because it doesn't need gas anymore.
storyBig: A classic car model is being transformed to run on electric power, reflecting the industry's shift towards sustainable energy as competition intensifies with global rivals.
think: How does using electric power help the planet?
bull: Electric cars help the earth stay clean.
bear: Not everyone might like the new style.
